sentences.text:
Smt. Keerti Kaur W/O Late Amar Jeet Singh ... vs State Of U.P.
Thru Principal Secretary ... on 20 December, 2022

Author: Ramesh Sinha
Bench: Ramesh Sinha
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Court No. - 1
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 8399 of 2010
Petitioner :- Smt. Keerti Kaur W/O Late Amar Jeet Singh And Ors.
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru Principal Secretary Home And Ors.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Gaurav Misra,Sp Shukla Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Pradeep Singh,Rk Singh Hon'ble Ramesh Sinha,J.
Hon'ble Ajai Kumar Srivastava-I,J.

This petition seeks issuance of a writ in the nature of Certiorari quashing the impugned Case Crime No. 294/2010 under Section s 272/273 IPC and 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, Police Station Kakori, District Licknow.
It appears that by efflux of time, the instant writ petition has become infructuous.
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed as infructuous.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
However, it is open for the petitioner(s) to move an appropriate application within two months from today, if the matter survives.
